principle: Every arm supplies exactly 4 field tags into the SAME fixed template. Arms differ ONLY in which varṇa-derived (or baseline) field is used; denotation is fixed by the anchor and never changed. Deterministic + seeded, NO per-item hand-polishing.

field_tag_extraction_rule.step_1: target word -> phoneme string -> varṇa sequence via bound G2P->varṇa pipeline (varna_lens, cmudict), same as B1.1/B1.2
field_tag_extraction_rule.step_2: for each varṇa in composition order, take its pole gloss from frozen bridge pool (b1_2_varna_bridge_pool.json, 34 entries) under the fixed read_op pole rule ('zero free choices')
field_tag_extraction_rule.step_3: reduce each pole gloss to a <=2-word neutral tag by a FIXED rule (lowercase; strip Sanskrit labels and binding/liberating wording; take head noun-phrase; no synonym substitution)
field_tag_extraction_rule.step_4: take first 4 tags by composition order
field_tag_extraction_rule.backfill_if_fewer_than_4: next varṇa in sequence; if still short, seeded draw from the global tag pool (recorded, never hand-chosen)

A_real.input_source: target word's REAL varṇa sequence (real G2P -> varṇa)

R_deranged.input_source: ANOTHER word's varṇa-derived tags, via frozen derangement pi (pi(w)!=w) fixed before judging
R_deranged.matching: broad category/length only where deterministic; else nearest by frozen order
R_deranged.failure_meaning: R_deranged ~ A_real => field not object-specific (crux; B1.1/B1.2 found this null)

R_scrambled.input_source: target word's OWN varṇas, order-disrupted (recorded deterministic scramble seed)
R_scrambled.field_derivation: same extraction over the scrambled sequence
R_scrambled.failure_meaning: R_scrambled ~ A_real => order carries nothing (CRITICAL; prior automated cosine 0.967)

R_random.input_source: 4 tags sampled from the global field-tag pool via fixed seed, excluding the word's own varṇa tags
R_random.controls_for: GENERIC symbolic tag fit (does any coherent tag set suffice?)
R_random.failure_meaning: R_random ~ A_real => generic resonance, not varṇa-specific

X_neutral.input_source: neutral / no-varṇa: 4 generic non-modulating filler tags (or bare no-modulation rendering)
X_neutral.controls_for: whether modulation adds ANY value over a content-free option
X_neutral.failure_meaning: X_neutral ~ A_real => modulation adds no value
X_neutral.must_not_become_dictionary_baseline: content-FREE generic filler; kept SEPARATE from the dictionary-derived semantic-only baseline (see semantic_baseline_spec)

R_semantic_near.input_source: a semantic near-neighbor word's real varṇa field

R_varna_near.input_source: a varṇa-near / semantic-far word's real field

primary_pairing: A_real vs R_deranged (crux); A_real must also beat R_scrambled, R_random, X_neutral, and the semantic-only baseline
